verdict.rationale: Zep automatically ingests raw chat messages into the user's Context Graph via thread.add_messages, performing entity and edge extraction with no manual curation. It consolidates memory over time through fact invalidation, a bi-temporal model that tracks how facts change, learned ontology, and thread summaries that Zep generates and updates incrementally. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of salience filtering (how Zep decides what is worth remembering versus discarding), explicit confirmation that extraction and consolidation run asynchronously in the background, and independent hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.
